nl: In billing/pricing.py, introduce a module-level constant MAX_RETRIES = 3 after the module docstring (one blank line before it, two blank lines after it) and use it in place of the number 3 in the three calculations. The string "3.0" in version() stays unchanged.
oracle_program:
edit "billing/pricing.py" changes: [{insert: "MAX_RETRIES = 3\n", line: 3, position: before}]
search /\b3\b(?!\.0")/ "billing/pricing.py" |> replace "MAX_RETRIES"
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('billing/pricing.py'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('"""Pricing helpers."""\n\n') == 1, 'billing/pricing.py'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('"""Pricing helpers."""\n\n', '"""Pricing helpers."""\n\nMAX_RETRIES = 3\n\n').encode())
p = pathlib.Path('billing/pricing.py'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('(1 + 3)') == 1, 'billing/pricing.py'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('(1 + 3)', '(1 + MAX_RETRIES)').encode())
p = pathlib.Path('billing/pricing.py'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('net * 3\n') == 1, 'billing/pricing.py'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('net * 3\n', 'net * MAX_RETRIES\n').encode())
p = pathlib.Path('billing/pricing.py'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('{net * 3:.2f}') == 1, 'billing/pricing.py'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('{net * 3:.2f}', '{net * MAX_RETRIES:.2f}').encode())
EOF
